QUOTE: Library code and the two `ssl_*2.c` programs see real field names... By default every field is therefore named `private_<name>`. Code outside the library that writes `ctx->state` gets a compile error... Applications have to define the macro themselves before including any Mbed TLS header.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the macro expands to plain `member` when MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS is defined and to `private_member` for ordinary consumers. It also names which code sees which form.
